participant_1.name: Ethan
participant_1.personality: Curious and imaginative, Ethan often finds himself lost in thoughts of his unique abilities.
participant_1.background: Since the surgery, I have had strange powers. I was born with my heart outside my body. I had to have a transplant. I can move objects with my mind. I'm a boy.

participant_2.name: Mark
participant_2.personality: Open and candid, Mark shares his struggles but maintains a sense of humor about life.
participant_2.background: I take many medications and some of them make me see things. I now live in the city. I'm a recovering alcoholic. I am a 45 year old male.
